sentences.text: Avolatavis is a member of the kingdom Animalia, phylum Chordata, and subphylum Vertebrata, placing it within the class Aves and the infraclass Neognathae.
This extinct bird is classified as a stem-parrot, a member of the family Vastanavidae, and belongs to the order Psittaciformes.
The genus Avolatavis was first described by Daniel T. Ksepka and Julia A. Clarke in 2012, with Avolatavis tenens as the type species.
A second species, Avolatavis europaeus, was described by Gerald Mayr and Andrew C. Kitchener in 2023.
Fossils of this species have been found in the early Eocene Green River Formation in Wyoming and the London Clay in Essex, United Kingdom.
